limitations: Observed market inputs and German national public-power/load aggregates are not VPP-metered physical or forecast data.
The public_power endpoint contains realized national observations, not archived day-ahead forecasts.
Market-wide auction results do not prove that the hypothetical plant qualified, bid, cleared, or received any particular award.
Market-wide balancing-energy results do not provide participant-specific activation or non-delivery settlement.
The original Study A optimizer, calibrated forecast files, scenario blocks, and solver run configuration remain unavailable; no profit or optimization result is produced.
Do not interpret the merged market data alone as evidence that the legacy profits were recalculated.
SMARD currently advises that wholesale-price data should not be used until further notice; do not use or publish the DE-LU day-ahead price series until its licensing status is clarified.
